title: Gaurishankar Lake, Bhavnagar - A Serene Escape Amid Nature
content:
Gaurishankar Lake, Bhavnagar

Located in the heart of Bhavnagar, Gaurishankar Lake (also known as Bor Talav) is one of the most popular and scenic attractions in the city. Built during the reign of Shree Gaurishankar Oza, the lake was developed to serve as a water reservoir for the city and has now become a favorite leisure destination for both locals and tourists. Surrounded by lush gardens, walking trails, and picnic spots, the lake offers a perfect setting for relaxation, photography, and evening strolls.

Spread over a vast area, Gaurishankar Lake is an ideal place for boating, bird watching, and enjoying tranquil sunsets. The calm waters reflect the beauty of the surrounding trees and sky, making it a paradise for nature lovers and photographers. Families often visit the lake for evening walks, children’s rides, and peaceful moments away from the city’s noise. During winter, the lake becomes a haven for migratory birds, adding to its natural charm.

With its combination of natural beauty and recreational facilities, Gaurishankar Lake stands as a symbol of Bhavnagar’s serene lifestyle and is a must-visit spot for anyone exploring the region.

Visiting Time

  • Timings: 6:00 AM - 8:00 PM
  • Best Time to Visit: October to February for pleasant weather and birdwatching.

Entry Fee

  • Entry: Free for all visitors
  • Boating Charges: Nominal fees apply for paddle or row boats.

How to Reach

  • By Air: The nearest airport is Bhavnagar Airport, just 5 km away.
  • By Train: Bhavnagar Terminus Railway Station is around 3 km from the lake.
  • By Road: The lake is easily accessible by auto, cab, or private vehicle from any part of the city.

Nearby Places to Visit

  • Takhteshwar Temple - A white marble hilltop temple offering panoramic views. 
  • Victoria Park - A lush green forest for nature walks and birdwatching.
  • Barton Library and Museum - A cultural heritage site showcasing local history.
  • Nilambag Palace - A stunning heritage palace turned luxury hotel.
  • Khodiyar Mandir - A revered temple dedicated to Goddess Khodiyar.

faqs.question: What is Gaurishankar Lake famous for?
faqs.answer: It’s known for its scenic beauty, boating facilities, and as a peaceful picnic and birdwatching spot in Bhavnagar.

faqs.question: Who built Gaurishankar Lake?
faqs.answer: The lake was developed under the supervision of Shree Gaurishankar Oza, the then-Deewan of Bhavnagar.

faqs.question: Is boating available at Gaurishankar Lake?
faqs.answer: Yes, boating facilities are available for visitors at affordable rates.

faqs.question: Is it suitable for families and children?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! It’s a family-friendly location with gardens, play areas, and open spaces for relaxation.

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Gaurishankar Lake?
faqs.answer: Early mornings and evenings, especially between October and February, are ideal for enjoying the lake’s beauty.
